_description: Held-identity batch 2b re-points (2026-11-18): the cards whose reviews name a different product than the listing, under the same rule as 2026-11-18-repoint.json (unanimous, or a majority of at least 6, consistent with the slug; listing stands where another card covers the product). Applied with tools/fix_wrong_listing.py --plan (correct_mpn, then unbind the old listing).
